# Custom Concrete Holland

> > Custom Concrete Holland provides residential and commercial concrete services throughout West Michigan, specializing in decorative stamped concrete, foundations, repairs, and custom installations.

Custom Concrete Holland is a full-service concrete contractor based in Holland, MI, serving the West Michigan region. The company offers comprehensive concrete solutions from structural foundations and walls to decorative stamped patios, polished floors, custom countertops, and professional maintenance and repair services.
